system.longDesc:
Cost: 2 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making a Fighting (Grappling) attack.

You and your target make opposed Fighting (Grappling) rolls; if you win, you and your target fall prone; your target takes an additional 1d6 damage and can’t stand up until you do, or until they succeed at an attack against you.
